initial_query: Find a hotel building to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA) for 30 residents in Turin with at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near healthcare services.
submitted_query: Find a hotel building to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA) for 30 residents in Turin with at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near healthcare services.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 1600 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND healthcare >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: Energy class D or better (A1 through D). Only the energy class is filtered here; the 1600 sqm gross floor area, 30-resident RSA use, Turin location and proximity to healthcare are outside the energy-efficiency scope of this agent.

The user wants the building to be near healthcare services. The healthcare 75th percentile is 75.06, so the threshold is set to 75 (rounded to the nearest integer) to require well-served healthcare proximity for a senior care facility.

The user explicitly requires at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is an explicit surface threshold. The capacity of 30 residents, the energy class D requirement, and the proximity to healthcare services are not REFERENCE COLUMNS and were not converted into filters. The hotel typology cannot be mapped because the list of available typologies is empty.
